title: Sharing depth without a false appearance

captions.physics: Passing on a chosen teaching thoughtfully
captions.energy: Seeking the inner substance of tradition

meaning: The depth of a chosen teaching can inspire you when passing it on brings the relief of participating on an honest foundation.
text: Behind an established teaching’s form, you may discover the substance that makes participation matter. The High Priestess in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish for inner depth. The Hierophant in the physical position describes shared actions: learning within a chosen tradition, explaining its foundations and transmitting experience to others. The Tower in emotions brings liberating relief when a mistaken requirement for perfection or outward authority falls away. It feels freeing that shared purpose can live honestly. Your transmission retains connection with its source without having to maintain an attractive but unsupported appearance.

At an open craft session, a familiar “compulsory” technique turns out to be relatively recent. Together, you explain what is known about its origin and demonstrate several documented ways of working. **Depth in transmission survives when a form need not pretend to be timeless.** Participants find it easier to try and ask. That relief matters to you too: an important skill already continues among people without depending on a story the available material cannot honestly confirm.

The difficulty may arise if being the explainers separates you too firmly from everyone else. Someone brings useful evidence, but it is not discussed until it fits your prepared programme. Deep interest and clear relief remain supportive. Action benefits from letting transmission travel back as well: fresh evidence can enrich a chosen teaching while preserving respect for its actual foundation.
